changes.what: Adds wrangler.jsonc with the REDIS Durable Object and the ColdTier R2 bucket
changes.why: The project configures its Worker only in Alchemy's alchemy.run.ts.

changes.what: Adds src/orange-entry.ts: src/do.ts and src/worker.ts rewritten as a plain Durable Object class and Worker, using the project's Store and SessionExecutor unchanged
changes.why: src/do.ts and src/worker.ts export Alchemy Effect layers. Only Alchemy's bundler turns them into a Worker, and `alchemy dev` needs a Cloudflare account.

knownFailures.step: a connection keeps its name while the object hibernates
knownFailures.note: WebSocket hibernation is not available on Rivet 3. Orange emulates it: it drops the idle object and keeps its sockets open, but the Rivet actor does not sleep while a socket is open. This step waits for every actor to sleep, so it fails with: Some actor was still awake.
